name: rt_sigsuspend
description: rt_sigsuspend() temporarily replaces the signal mask of the calling thread with the mask provided and suspends the thread until a signal is delivered. It supports an enlarged sigset_t for real-time signals and requires the size of the signal set as an argument.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Pointer to the new signal mask

parameters.name: sigsetsize
parameters.description: Size in bytes of the signal set in mask

return_value.failure: errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: mask points to memory which is not a valid part of the process address space
The call was interrupted by a signal
sigsetsize is not equal to sizeof(sigset_t)
